description: Drive Maps GPO authored via GPMC Editor — user scope, four items covering update/replace/delete/create actions, FilterOs+FilterRunOnce ILT, Unicode path and XML-entity label
classification_note: Authored through gpme.msc on Windows Server 2025 and captured via Backup-GPO. GPMC natively emitted all elements.

items.windows_meaning: Map \\filesrv\home to drive M: with label 'Home Drive'. Persistent, uses specified letter. Action Update: create if absent, modify if present. FilterRunOnce promoted to apply_once; FilterOs ILT retained.
items.label: Home Drive

items.windows_meaning: Map \\filesrv\projects to drive P: with label 'Projects'. Not persistent. Action Replace: delete and recreate unconditionally. removePolicy=1, bypassErrors=1.
items.label: Projects
